articles.title: Ether, DeFi fall twice as hard as bitcoin as equities selloff resumes
articles.snippet: Bitcoin (BTC) is down 1.2% since midnight UTC as the stock selloff resumes, with ether (ETH) and DeFi tokens falling about twice as far.

articles.title: Trump willing to pardon Jensen Huang, says it won’t be necessary
articles.snippet: The president’s remarks come days before Jensen Huang is due to face congressional questioning over national security concerns and US chip export controls.

articles.title: Coldcard reveals how Bitcoin wallet flaw went undetected for over 5 years
articles.snippet: Coldcard maker Coinkite explained why years of security checks failed to catch the flaw and said it has yet to decide on compensation for affected customers.

articles.title: South Korea Moves to Lift Its ICO Ban After Nearly a Decade
articles.snippet: The Financial Services Commission’s draft Digital Asset Act would let domestic projects sell tokens again under IPO-style disclosure rules, reversing a 2017 ban that mostly pushed Korean issuers offshore.

articles.title: Morning Minute: Jensen Returns, Markets Soar (Except Crypto)
articles.snippet: It was a very green Monday for most markets, but crypto couldn’t hold the pump as ETF sellers race for the exits.
